scope: Infernal Dragon, native Blazing Fireball/Fire Area and three guardian combat semantics only.
summary: Dragon phase and causing-entity admission, native arrow/fire/explosion/breath paths and independent guardian control resolved; HP and ignition/phase/control remain separate.

facts.admission: InfernalDragonEntity.hurt first delegates BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY unchanged. Otherwise phases -1,1,4 reject before any incoming modifier; exact IN_FIRE/FALL/CACTUS, positive DATA_HIT_ANIMTIME or DATA_SPAWN_ANIMTIME reject next. Remaining phase0 hits multiply amount by2 only when DamageSource.getEntity() (CAUSING entity) instanceof Projectile; then every phase divides by2 if that causing entity is IceSpikeProjectileEntity. Finally original source enters inherited hurt. No getDirectEntity test. Owned native arrows and owned Ice Spike indirect_magic have their Living owner as cause, so neither modifier follows merely from projectile delivery. Ownerless Ice Spike onHitEntity explicitly falls back to itself as cause: phase0 x2 then /2 nets1; other admitted phases /2. Do not fabricate such a source or claim a native ownerless producer; unresolved-owner/reload fixture must use genuine projectile lifecycle. Incoming modifiers are NOT a second Stage point.
facts.traits_and_stats: canFreeze=false, fireImmune=true, isPushable=false, causeFallDamage=false, knockback resistance1. Native Entity/Living gates still apply after Dragon override, including fire-tag admission; bypassing the local exact-source checks is not a blanket bypass of downstream events. createAttributes gives HP250, armor15, attack14. finalizeSpawn applies config Dragon Health250 and Armor25 defaults and fills HP; spawner hook also applies configured HP. DRAGON_ATK default15 has only its static declaration PUTSTATIC and zero GETSTATIC consumers in installed whole-artifact census: do not report it as applied attack damage. Default phase0 and legacy counters0; positive counter guards are code contracts, not proof that normal native Dragon hits set them.
facts.phase_lifecycle: Native BossSpawner callback with resolved wall position establishes HadSpawner=true, phase-1, intro230 and cinematic effects230; closes arena exit and anchors wall position. Server tick manages phases then runs handleAttackDamage. Intro timer done ->phase0. At HP ratio<=.85 phase0 enters1 (wall variant knocked_down90, relocate to spawner, cinematic90); this earlier return shadows its later .5/.25 branches. Phase1 without spawner advances2 immediately; with spawner waits knocked-down timer. Phase2 <=.5 enters3 (its later .25 test is shadowed). Phase3 <=.25 stops circling, disables noGravity, waits onGround then phase4 transition230 with cinematic225; completion phase5. No phase HP refill/clamp here. Ground/flight/circle pools change delivery position and cadence, not source identity. Native setState remaps names containing flight/fire/wall to idle while doAttack retains attack/head state; actual handleAttackDamage has only attack!=null, not an isCinematic/isDeath guard. Include retained-attack-at-transition fixture rather than assuming all attacks cease in cinematics. Shared timer completion is strictly >duration.
facts.cinematic_and_death: onCinematicStarted applies native Slowness amplifier4 and Resistance amplifier255 for passed ticks to players in AABB.ofSize(position,128,128,128), no source/LOS/creative exclusion here. Native Applicable/effect rules remain; Roll can reject both effects (including beneficial Resistance). Resistance reduction max(amount*(25-5*(amp+1))/25,0) makes ordinary eligible damage0; BYPASSES_EFFECTS/RESISTANCE still matters. No scaling of effect amplifier/duration. shouldCancelDeath sets dead180, disables noGravity, applies cinematic180 and returns true; while dead returns !isTimerDone. Shared legacy lethal restoration to .1 occurs before Post, excluding BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY. Dead completion requests native selfhurt999999 PLAYER_ATTACK with getSourceEntity as direct/causing entity (may be fallback Living/self, not necessarily Player), result ignored; script finalization, NO Stage. No new production change.
facts.melee: Server handleAttackDamage dispatches claw timer43 range6 scale.834, bite25 range7 scale.667, tail32 range8 scale1, each arc argument120. dealMeleeAttackDamage queries Players in Dragon BB.inflate(range), excludes spectator/creative, requires Euclidean position distance<=range and actual yaw expression abs(degrees(atan2(toPlayer.z,toPlayer.x)-radians(yRot))), if>180 replaced by360-difference, <=120. Preserve this expression, do not reinterpret as a conventional centered half-angle cone. No LOS check. Shared attackEntity requests current ATTACK_DAMAGE*scale, then enchantment modification, mob_attack direct/causing Dragon. Returned boolean is ignored here: raw player.push(normalized full toPlayer vector X/Z*1.2,Y.4) follows even rejected HP. Stage once at final shared hurt amount, never scale attribute and helper both. Ground/flight_dash motion itself has no separate hurt producer.
facts.fireball_delivery: Native Dragon spawnFireball occurs at head timer9,19,29; target nonnull, aims at target eyes, owner=Dragon. First two baseDamage1 speed2; third base1.5 speed3, inaccuracy0, anonymous knockback1 and pierce0, noGravity. FlamingSkeletonGuardFireball timed producer independently uses base1 speed1.5 inaccuracy3 owner=guard with same knockback1/pierce0. Collision is inherited AbstractArrow: native owner/vehicle exclusion, PvP, Neo projectile-impact veto, deflection and hurt admission retained; amount ceil(clamp(current speed*enchantment-adjusted base,0,INT_MAX)) plus native crit only if set. Actual factories do not set crit/fired weapon. Source minecraft:arrow, direct ball, cause owner else ball; NOT fireball or fire-tag damage by name. hurttrue non-Enderman triggers native post-hit/enchantment/knockback, custom arrow-count decrement. Stage only final arrow hurt amount. Inherited arrow baseDamage/owner persist; anonymous captured knockback is not serialized, registered reloaded class default0: future fixture. Static shoot convenience helpers have no external invokestatic native callers; armor producer exists but is reserved for equipment review.
facts.fireball_secondaries: BlazingFireBallEntity.onHitEntity invokes super then HitsLivingEntityProcedure regardless of hit success/Enderman early return inside super. Server spawns FireArea at hit entity block position, then discards ball; despite procedure name no Living-only predicate, and no explosion on this path. Block callback invokes super then spawns FireArea at ball block position; if spawn succeeds, radius2 fire=true ExplosionInteraction.NONE explosion with new FireArea as source; discard independent. Flying-tick callback after super queries ALL entities in center box inflated.5 (full side1), excludes only BlazingFireBallEntity and calls igniteForSeconds3, no owner/LOS/hurt/impact-event gate. Authoritative server executes it; callback also runs client. Thus projectile veto may stop impact payload while proximity ignition remains distinct. Tick discards inGround. Do not couple any of these callbacks to arrow hurttrue.
facts.fire_area_and_explosion: FireArea is plain Entity, no stored owner. Registered dimensions3.5x.3. Server tick iterates Living touching its own BB, excludes fireImmune, requests ownerless minecraft:in_fire1.5, then independently igniteForSeconds4. Counter starts130, decrements until nonpositive discard; water/bubble discard; counter saved. Block-impact native explosion direct=FireArea, causing=null, minecraft:explosion (no ownership transfer from ball). Radius2 gives distance radius4; native exposure formula ((q*q+q)/2*7*4+1), q=(1-distance/4)*seenPercent, only native admitted entities/range/nonzero direction and calculator.shouldDamageEntity. Native ExplosionStart veto and Detonate list/event respected; native independent impulse/explosion-knockback resistance and event need separate fixture from hurtboolean. NONE means KEEP blocks, not zero HP or zero fire: finalizeExplosion fire loop remains, 1/3 at selected air over solid-render support, before ServerLevel clears toBlow for packet. Stage once final explosion hurt argument after exposure, not radius/exposure plus HP; FireArea1.5 separately once at its hurt call.
facts.breath: Native fire_breathing head timer25..60 every5 (8 emissions when uninterrupted), target nonnull determines aim. Initial aim target eye jitter +-1.5 each axis and sprint offset1.5 away; retained aim lerps .5 toward current target if distance>.5. March100 steps*.5 (max50). First non-air block beyond squared distance25 stops BEFORE player callback at that step, writes FIRE in3x3 above impact only if air/cobblestone; cobblestone random removal does not prevent subsequent fire replacement. No ordinary LOS raycast through first5 blocks. Each unobstructed sample iterates level.players, not all Living; squared distance <.5 sprinting or<1.25 otherwise. No creative/spectator/owner/alive filter in callback. setRemainingFireTicks overwrites with100 sprinting/250 otherwise, then ONLY when hasEffect(FIRE_RESISTANCE) requests ownerless magic1.5/2 respectively; hurt return ignored. Native magic has no IS_FIRE tag so Fire Resistance does not itself reject this damage; Resistance/armor-bypass rules and native events remain. No per-player/sample dedup; iframes control repeated HP admission. Stage once at magic hurt, not ignition duration/number of samples. Native fire blocks and subsequent on_fire are separate routes.
facts.burning_and_tags: Vanilla ignition max-extends ticks via igniteForSeconds; breath direct setRemainingFireTicks can shorten an existing burn. Entity server baseTick requests ownerless on_fire1 every20 remaining ticks when non-fireImmune and not in lava; Fire Resistance rejection occurs in Living hurt. Native fire-block contact uses in_fire/fireDamage (ordinary FIRE1) and independent ignition counter, also native fireImmune handling. Pin tags: arrow/mob_attack/player_attack Neo physical; magic/indirect_magic Neo magic and armor+shield bypass; in_fire is fire/environment but NO armor/shield bypass; on_fire fire/environment and armor+shield bypass; explosion IS_EXPLOSION/no_knockback but NO armor/shield bypass. None of these eight bypass resistance/effects/enchantments/invulnerability/cooldown. Explosion difficulty scaling ALWAYS; other pinned resource scaling when_caused_by_living_non_player (ownerless sources lack Living cause). Preserve native source credit loss for breath/pool/burn/explosion; no fallback owner. Stage once per actual final native hurt payload, including shared vanilla burn/fire paths only with proven origin attribution; do not globally scale unrelated fire or also scale ignition.
facts.guardians: DragonGuardSword, FlamingSkeletonGuardSword, FlamingSkeletonGuardFireball are independent Monster subclasses, no owner contract and no Dragon summon producer proven. Registry/placement routes are genuine fixtures; do not assign Dragon ownership. All have normal MeleeAttackGoal canPerformAttack cooldown, distanceSq<ownWidth^2+targetWidth, native sensingLOS -> Mob.doHurtTarget current attribute/enchant/native mob_attack. Defaults attack7/9/4 respectively. Separate baseTick timed procedures use target identity in box, no LOS: swords cooldown>=40 starts20 when target within2.75-inflated center; hit remaining12 within3.5; cooldown increments with target within8; initial30. If attacker alive requests explicit mob_attack (direct=causing guard) current attribute, no enchantment amount helper in timed call. Independently adds velocity .2*look XZ,+.1Y even hurtfalse. Flaming sword also blocking Living victim AND Player -> active-use item cooldown100, independent of hurt/alive attacker and no stopUsingItem call. Fireball guard ready>=70, starts25 within8, emits at19 within8.5 if alive/server; cooldown increments within16. All fireImmune and exact IN_FIRE veto; timed state saved. Native ordinary melee and timed hit/ranged callbacks can both run: distinct fixtures, native iframes retained.
facts.exclusions_and_coverage: Rendering, sounds/particles, loot/acquisition and FireArea smelting are excluded briefly. Flight/circling/arena blocks reviewed only where admission/aim/reach changes; no new numeric payload inferred. DragonArmorEvents native BlazingFireball producer remains equipment work, not repeated here. IceSpike full control/persistence/producer review remains Yeti, only Dragon source predicate resolved here. No custom DamageType added; foundation two custom keys unchanged. Static semantics complete for Dragon/three guardians, all future fixtures unexecuted; whole Bosses Rise still PARTIAL.
